handoff_hint: In this project a handoff means: write the diagnosis into docs/tasks/task-NNN-slug/, then tell the user to /clear and re-run the phase command (/design-task, /plan-task, /execute-task) for the same task id — each phase resumes from the committed artifacts of the prior one, so nothing is lost.
